solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Father on horseback in 3-D picture book

parts.note: pop is an informal word for a father
a rider who is mounted is said to be up

explanation.surface: Dad on a horse appears in a children's book with three-dimensional pictures.
explanation.definitionFit: A pop-up is a children's book whose pictures stand up in three dimensions as the pages open.

clue.text: Star, English, brings wind instrument

parts.note: a pip is the star worn on an army officer's shoulder to show rank

explanation.surface: A star performer from England brings along a wind instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A pipe is a simple tubular instrument played by blowing, such as a recorder or bagpipe chanter.

clue.text: Unusually poor trifle put on end of table for dessert

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece is put on, or after, the other
arranged unusually, so the letters of poor trifle are reordered
the end of table is its final letter

explanation.surface: A disappointing trifle is placed at the end of the table as pudding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unusually' rearranges POOR TRIFLE into PROFITEROL; 'put on' adds the E that 'end of table' supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: A profiterole is a small choux pastry ball filled with cream, served as a sweet course.

clue.text: Satisfy publican, initially, with tenancy agreement

indicators.note: initially picks out the opening letter of publican

parts.note: a lease is a contract letting property to a tenant

explanation.surface: A landlord is kept happy by signing a tenancy agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: to satisfy someone is to give them pleasure or gratify them.

clue.text: Spelling aid?

parts.note: looks like a dictionary or speller, but a spell here is a magic charm, so the aid is a wizard's tool

explanation.surface: Something that helps you spell words correctly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spelling' suggests orthography; read it as casting spells instead.
explanation.definitionFit: A wizard waves this stick to cast enchantments, so it literally aids spell-casting.

clue.text: Rocklike object, weird to eremite

indicators.note: weird suggests the letters of to eremite are in strange order

explanation.surface: A stony object seems strange to a hermit.
explanation.definitionFit: A space rock that survives its fall to Earth is a stony or metallic lump of matter.

clue.text: Good landlord, in spirit

parts.note: an innkeeper or landlord is the host of his guests

explanation.surface: A kind innkeeper is in good spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: a spirit can be a phantom or apparition of the dead.

clue.text: Draughts in country house retreat

definitions.meaning: the board game draughts, called checkers in the US, also goes by this name in Britain
the Prime Minister's official country residence in Buckinghamshire

explanation.surface: Cold air blows through a stately home used as a getaway.
explanation.walkthrough: Chequers is the British Prime Minister's country house; draughts is the British name for checkers.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: the game of draughts, and the famous official weekend residence of British premiers.

clue.text: Suitable in a small part

parts.note: pt is the short form of part, so a small version of the word

explanation.surface: An actor is right for a minor role.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: something apt is fitting or appropriate for its purpose.

clue.text: Opera company may give CD yearly to eccentric

indicators.note: eccentric means odd, so the letters of CD yearly to are arranged oddly

explanation.surface: An opera troupe might hand out a recording each year to an oddball.
explanation.definitionFit: The D'Oyly Carte company is famous for staging Gilbert and Sullivan's comic operas.

clue.text: In favour of international demo

parts.note: pro means for or in favour of
a Test is an international cricket or rugby match

explanation.surface: Supporting a demonstration involving several nations.
explanation.definitionFit: A demo is short for demonstration, a public march or rally of dissent.

clue.text: Revolt affected yobbos' leader, clearly

indicators.note: affected means altered, so the letters of revolt are reworked
the leader of yobbos' is its first letter

explanation.surface: A rebellion swayed the gang's ringleader in plain view.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: done openly and plainly, with nothing concealed.

clue.text: At home, soon to imbibe drink, drop of port not easily obtainable

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: imbibe means take in, so one word swallows the others

parts.note: shortly means soon
to sup is to drink

indicators.note: a drop of port is just its first letter

explanation.surface: Planning to drink at home soon, but port is scarce.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to imbibe' and 'drop of' are the signals; the drink goes into the middle of the word for soon, not at either end.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for something scarce, hard to get because there is not enough of it.

clue.text: Supernatural being got reptiles jittery

indicators.note: jittery means shaky and nervous, so the letters of got reptiles are jumbled

explanation.surface: A spirit made the snakes and lizards nervous.
explanation.definitionFit: A noisy mischievous spirit, said to throw objects and make knocking sounds in a house.

clue.text: Excellent form for one starting school?

definitions.meaning: a form is a school class, and the earliest one is where a new pupil begins

explanation.surface: The ideal class for a new pupil.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: top quality, and literally the opening class or form a beginning pupil joins.

clue.text: On the way back, came across one courting couple

indicators.note: travelling back means the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: met means encountered or came across
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Returning home, I bumped into someone dating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On the way back' turns METI around.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal term for two people in a romantic relationship, a pair publicly linked.

clue.text: In winter, a liaison, among other things

indicators.note: in signals the letters sit inside the words winter, a liaison

explanation.surface: During the cold season there was an affair, among other events.
explanation.definitionFit: A Latin phrase used in English meaning including other items not listed.

clue.text: Ditch worker, maybe, being incisive

parts.note: a trench is a long narrow ditch
an ant is a typical worker in a colony; maybe marks it as an example

explanation.surface: A labourer digging a ditch is being sharp.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: trenchant comments are keen and cutting, piercing to the heart of a matter.

clue.text: Rupert working in A&E: an opening

indicators.note: in places the reworked letters between the A and E

parts.note: the letters A and E as printed, an accident and emergency department

indicators.note: working means operating or in motion, so the letters of Rupert are shifted

explanation.surface: Rupert has a job in the hospital casualty department: a vacancy.
explanation.walkthrough: A&E is the British name for a hospital emergency department; here its two letters, guided by 'in', hold Rupert once 'working' has jumbled him.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: an aperture is a gap or hole, such as the opening of a camera lens.

clue.text: Who's redesigned still, we hear, is the best exhibit?

indicators.note: redesigned means remade, so the letters of who's are reorganised
we hear signals a word that sounds like another

parts.note: peace is stillness or quiet

explanation.surface: An exhibition piece which has been remodelled is still the best?
explanation.definitionFit: A showpiece is the finest example, displayed for admiration.

clue.text: Warm up for race

definitions.meaning: a qualifying round of a competition

explanation.surface: A warm-up before competing.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: to raise the temperature of, and a preliminary contest in athletics.

clue.text: Very cold beer

definitions.meaning: intensely chilly, as of a biting wind
a British type of hoppy draught ale

explanation.surface: An ice-cold pint.
explanation.walkthrough: Bitter is a traditional British pale ale.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: piercingly chilly weather, and a well-hopped English ale.

clue.text: Choosing the best from Chekhov's orchard?

definitions.meaning: selecting only the most favourable items
Chekhov wrote The Cherry Orchard, so gathering fruit there

explanation.surface: Selecting the finest fruit from the Russian playwright's trees.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for selective choosing, and literally gathering the fruit in Chekhov's famous play setting.

clue.text: A pot I ordered in courtyard

indicators.note: ordered means arranged, so the letters of a pot I are put in a new order

explanation.surface: I ordered a plant pot for the courtyard.
explanation.definitionFit: A paved outdoor area next to a house, akin to a small yard or court.

clue.text: Reject, years after study

indicators.note: after means the years letter follows the study word

parts.note: a den is a private room or study

explanation.surface: Turning someone down after many years of study.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: to refuse or rebuff a request or claim.

clue.text: A sailor on the radio in storm

indicators.note: on the radio means heard rather than seen, signalling a sound-alike

parts.note: a salt is an old sailor, so a salt

explanation.surface: A seaman speaks on air during a gale.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: to storm a position is to attack it violently.

clue.text: Short petty argument in health resort

indicators.note: short means cut, so the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a spat is a small quarrel

explanation.surface: A brief squabble breaks out at the wellness retreat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Short' removes the final T from SPAT.
explanation.definitionFit: A spa is a resort with mineral springs or treatments for wellbeing.

clue.text: A big step up?

definitions.note: up as in mounted on a horse, with legs on either side

parts.note: a stride is a long step

explanation.surface: A huge leap upward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' looks part of the step phrase, but it is the definition: a rider up on a horse sits with legs either side.
explanation.definitionFit: Sitting astride means with a leg on each side, as a rider mounted on horseback.

clue.text: Patsy, first to see about two animals

indicators.note: first to picks the opening letter of see

parts.note: C stands for circa, Latin for about
an ape and a goat

explanation.surface: A dupe is the first to see a pair of beasts nearby.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: a patsy is someone made to take the blame for others.

clue.text: Bad-tempered lines written about a tense time

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the lines wrap the other letters

parts.note: RY is short for railway, a set of lines
T is the grammar abbreviation for tense

explanation.surface: Irritable verse composed during a stressful period.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonyms: informal British word for irritable or cross.
